text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing treating Gold City's 
injury during practice—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer. It wasn't anything 
serious, so let's get back to practice. No 
time to waste.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Until Mane-G comes to pick me up, I should 
still be able to do a few more runs, 
right?
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day for practice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why? You already patched me up, so I 
can totally run through something like 
this.
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, it'll affect your races.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, our time is limited enough as it is! 
I swear I'll be back in training by 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I calmed down the frustrated Gold City and 
had her rest in the infirmary until it was 
time for her modeling work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I need to focus properly this time. 
I caught myself thinking about work 
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as I don't let my guard 
down, I'm totally fine. A tiny sprain like 
this is a piece of c—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way... Another sprain? Was I always 
this spaced out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Gold City's injury has 
worsened. I decided to have her sit out of 
practice today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what they'll ask in the 
interview after this and all. —Wait, no, 
pull it together!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Modeling work and running. If you're doing 
both, knowing how to switch gears is 
essential.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Since they went through the trouble of 
treating my injury, I have to make this 
training worthwhile!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dedication fully set on practice, Gold 
City successfully completed her scheduled 
routine without a hitch.
